title: He Volunteered to Get Sent to Auschwitz on Purpose
description:
Witold Pilecki, a Polish resistance officer, deliberately got himself arrested and sent to Auschwitz in 1940 to gather intelligence and smuggle reports to the Allies.

Did you know this actually happened? Let me know in the comments.
